$comment: evor-eval-bench stub server — the evor tool surface (angles E2, E3, E4, T3).
Registered under the name `evor` on purpose. ci/bench-run.mjs allows
['mcp__evor', 'Read', 'Glob', 'Grep'] by default, so a server registered under
any other name would have every call refused by the permission system — and a
permission denial is a VOID under §4.1, not a measurement. The name is the
difference between a scored run and 46 unusable ones.
Absolute path: --mcp-config resolves the command relative to the CLI's cwd,
not to this file, and a relative path silently produced a session with NO evor
The server has nothing to serve without EVOR_BENCH_STUB_SCRIPT, which
ci/bench-run.mjs writes per (scenario, repeat) outside the agent's sandbox.
